Gold Questions（标注答案）
GQ_001 · primary
Can public amphibian and reptile RNA-seq data reveal hidden viral diversity in under-sampled vertebrate hosts?
required elements: public amphibian and reptile RNA-seq, under-sampled vertebrate hosts, hidden viral diversity, assembly or transcriptome mining, novel viruses
acceptable variants:
• Can public ectotherm vertebrate transcriptomes reveal uncharacterized viruses?
• Does RNA-seq mining expand amphibian and reptile viral diversity?
unacceptable variants:
✗ Do amphibians have viruses?
✗ Can SRA be used for virology?
GQ_002 · secondary
Do recovered amphibian/reptile viruses occupy basal or divergent positions within known viral families?
required elements: recovered viruses, amphibian or reptile hosts, basal or divergent positions, known viral families, phylogenetic analysis
acceptable variants:
• Can ectotherm-vertebrate viruses reveal divergent family-level lineages?
• Do public RNA-seq assemblies contain basal viral clades?
unacceptable variants:
✗ Can we classify viral families?
✗ Are sequences novel?
